mapper.select: SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id,s.excerpt_id,s.ordinal,e.owner_id AS excerpt_owner_id, e.id AS actual_excerpt_id,e.attachment_id,e.attachment_sha256,a.owner_id AS attachment_owner_id, a.id AS actual_attachment_id,a.file_name,a.sha256 AS actual_sha256,e.origin,e.run_id,e.segment_id, e.locator,e.text,e.start_offset,e.end_offset,NULL AS kind FROM ai_material_draft_source s LEFT JOIN material_excerpt e ON e.owner_id=s.owner_id AND e.id=s.excerpt_id LEFT JOIN material_attachment a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.id=e.attachment_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY s.ordinal,s.excerpt_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.owner_id,v.item_id,v.id AS version_id,v.version_number,v.title,v.content_json, i.owner_id AS item_owner_id,i.kind AS item_kind,i.status AS item_status,i.project_id, p.owner_id AS project_owner_id,p.id AS actual_project_id,p.kind AS project_kind FROM preparation_version v LEFT JOIN preparation_item i ON i.owner_id=v.owner_id AND i.id=v.item_id LEFT JOIN preparation_item p ON p.owner_id=i.owner_id AND p.id=i.project_id WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.item_id=#{itemId} AND v.id=#{versionId} LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT i.owner_id,i.id AS item_id,i.kind,i.status,i.project_id,i.verification,i.source_generation,i.revision, i.current_version_id,i.version_number,v.owner_id AS version_owner_id,v.item_id AS version_item_id, v.id AS actual_version_id,v.version_number AS actual_version_number FROM preparation_item i LEFT JOIN preparation_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=i.current_version_id WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{itemId} LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.owner_id,e.id,e.root_item_id,e.root_kind,e.root_title,e.root_project_id,e.change_kind, e.previous_version_id,e.previous_version_number,e.previous_generation,e.previous_revision,e.previous_status, e.previous_verification,e.current_version_id,e.current_version_number,e.current_generation,e.current_revision, e.current_status,e.current_verification,e.created_at, previous_version.owner_id AS previous_owner_id,previous_version.item_id AS previous_item_id, previous_version.id AS actual_previous_id,previous_version.version_number AS actual_previous_number, previous_version.title AS previous_title,current_version.owner_id AS current_owner_id, current_version.item_id AS current_item_id,current_version.id AS actual_current_id, current_version.version_number AS actual_current_number FROM preparation_knowledge_event e LEFT JOIN preparation_version previous_version ON previous_version.owner_id=e.owner_id AND previous_version.item_id=e.root_item_id AND previous_version.id=e.previous_version_id LEFT JOIN preparation_version current_version ON current_version.owner_id=e.owner_id AND current_version.item_id=e.root_item_id AND current_version.id=e.current_version_id WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.root_item_id=#{itemId} AND (e.previous_generation=#{generation} OR e.current_generation=#{generation}) ORDER BY e.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.owner_id,r.item_id,r.version_id,r.excerpt_id,e.owner_id AS excerpt_owner_id, e.id AS actual_excerpt_id,e.attachment_id,e.attachment_sha256,a.owner_id AS attachment_owner_id, a.id AS actual_attachment_id,a.sha256 AS actual_sha256 FROM preparation_material_reference r LEFT JOIN material_excerpt e ON e.owner_id=r.owner_id AND e.id=r.excerpt_id LEFT JOIN material_attachment a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.id=e.attachment_id
WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY r.excerpt_id,r.item_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT owner_id,target_item_id,target_version_id,source_kind, preparation_source_item_id AS preparation_item_id,preparation_source_version_id AS preparation_version_id, knowledge_source_item_id AS knowledge_item_id,knowledge_source_version_id AS knowledge_version_id, collection_source_item_id AS collection_item_id,collection_source_version_id AS collection_version_id,use_type FROM preparation_reference
WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND target_version_id=#{versionId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.owner_id,a.session_id,a.question_id,a.id AS answer_id,a.version_number AS answer_number, a.answer_condition,a.content_json AS answer_content_json,q.owner_id AS question_owner_id, q.id AS actual_question_id,q.session_id AS question_session_id, s.owner_id AS session_owner_id,s.id AS actual_session_id,a.created_at FROM training_answer a LEFT JOIN training_question q ON q.owner_id=a.owner_id AND q.id=a.question_id LEFT JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=a.owner_id AND s.id=a.session_id
WHERE a.owner_id=#{owner} AND a.id=#{answerId} ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT q.owner_id,q.session_id,q.id AS question_id,q.source_question_id,q.source_version_id,q.title,q.stage,q.question_kind, q.root_question_id,q.parent_question_id,q.parent_answer_id,q.ai_task_id,q.snapshot_json, s.owner_id AS session_owner_id,s.id AS actual_session_id,q.position_index FROM training_question q LEFT JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=q.owner_id AND s.id=q.session_id WHERE q.owner_id=#{owner} AND q.id=#{questionId} ORDER BY q.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.owner_id,t.id AS task_id,t.purpose,t.status AS task_status,t.current_attempt_id,t.attempt_count, t.manifest_json,t.manifest_hash,t.candidate_json,e.owner_id AS binding_owner_id,e.task_id AS binding_task_id, e.session_id,e.question_id,e.answer_id,a.owner_id AS attempt_owner_id,a.task_id AS attempt_task_id, a.id AS attempt_id,a.attempt_number,a.status AS attempt_status,s.owner_id AS session_owner_id, s.id AS actual_session_id,s.mode AS session_mode,s.config_json AS session_config_json FROM ai_task t LEFT JOIN ai_evaluation e ON e.owner_id=t.owner_id AND e.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN ai_attempt a ON a.owner_id=t.owner_id AND a.task_id=t.id AND a.id=t.current_attempt_id LEFT JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=e.owner_id AND s.id=e.session_id
WHERE t.owner_id=#{owner} AND t.id=#{taskId} LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.owner_id,t.id AS task_id,t.purpose,t.status AS task_status,t.current_attempt_id,t.attempt_count, t.manifest_json,t.manifest_hash,t.candidate_json,f.owner_id AS binding_owner_id,f.task_id AS binding_task_id, f.session_id,f.question_id AS parent_question_id,f.answer_id AS parent_answer_id,f.root_question_id, f.generation,f.generated_question_id,a.owner_id AS attempt_owner_id,a.task_id AS attempt_task_id, a.id AS attempt_id,a.attempt_number,a.status AS attempt_status,s.owner_id AS session_owner_id, s.id AS actual_session_id,s.context_json AS session_context_json FROM ai_task t LEFT JOIN ai_follow_up f ON f.owner_id=t.owner_id AND f.task_id=t.id LEFT JOIN ai_attempt a ON a.owner_id=t.owner_id AND a.task_id=t.id AND a.id=t.current_attempt_id LEFT JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=f.owner_id AND s.id=f.session_id
WHERE t.owner_id=#{owner} AND t.id=#{taskId} LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id,r.owner_id,r.session_id,r.question_id,r.question_mode,r.baseline_kind, r.baseline_session_id,r.baseline_question_id,r.baseline_answer_id,r.recollection_id, r.recollection_version_id,r.recollection_revision,s.owner_id AS session_owner_id, s.id AS actual_session_id,s.mode AS session_mode,s.config_json AS session_config_json, s.question_count,q.id AS actual_question_id FROM review_repractice r LEFT JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=r.owner_id AND s.id=r.session_id
LEFT JOIN training_question q ON q.owner_id=r.owner_id AND q.session_id=r.session_id WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.session_id=#{sessionId} ORDER BY r.id,q.position_index,q.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.owner_id,s.task_id,s.excerpt_id,s.ordinal,e.owner_id AS excerpt_owner_id, e.id AS actual_excerpt_id,e.attachment_id,e.attachment_sha256,a.owner_id AS attachment_owner_id, a.id AS actual_attachment_id,a.file_name,a.sha256 AS actual_sha256,e.origin,e.run_id,e.segment_id, e.locator,e.text,e.start_offset,e.end_offset,s.kind FROM ai_fact_draft_material s LEFT JOIN material_excerpt e ON e.owner_id=s.owner_id AND e.id=s.excerpt_id LEFT JOIN material_attachment a ON a.owner_id=e.owner_id AND a.id=e.attachment_id WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY s.ordinal,s.excerpt_id LIMIT #{limit}
